text:
Type: grey wood grain picture frame
Use: displaying a photo or print on a shelf, a desk or a wall; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: rustic, farmhouse, coastal
Materials: wide frame with a textured brushed wood grain in a grey wash finish, white mat, clear front panel
Colors: light weathered grey, white mat
Shape: rectangular frame with a broad flat bevelled border and mitered corners, small white mat around the picture, chunky and solid
Feel: rustic, calm, weathered, natural
Goes with: whitewashed wood, linen, blue or grey tones; coastal, farmhouse or rustic rooms

product.name: HAVERDAL
product.description: Can be used hanging or standing, both horizontally and vertically, to fit in the space available.
